office_does: The treasurer collects property taxes, invests and accounts for county and district funds, and pays county warrants.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Chief Deputy Assessor Toni Graham is the only candidate for the open seat.

candidates.summary: Stevens County chief deputy assessor and Marine Corps veteran, running for the open treasurer's seat.
highlights: Chief Deputy Assessor; formerly worked in the Treasurer's Office [S1]
Treasurer Leslie Valz, elected in 2022, is not on the ballot [S1][S2]
